This plot is only a quarter hectare of beans mixed with other things, and beans do not need much fertilizer anyway — they feed themselves from the soil if I weed them well. I keep the little fertilizer I can get for my maize plot, that is where the food comes from. I saved some seed from last season's harvest like I always do, and my son will help me weed when he is home from piecework. I have no money for chemicals and no way to water this plot in the dry months.
